 Naz Reid (illness) probable Monday 
 by Nicholas Rodriguez | Hornets Correspondent | Mon, Oct 26th 2026, 2:06pm EDT 
 Naz Reid has been added to the Charlotte Hornets' injury report for Monday's game against the Washington Wizards due to an illness. He is listed as probable. ( Charlotte Hornets PR on X ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 While any late addition to the injury report is a concern, Reid is listed as probable, so fantasy managers shouldn't be too worried. Still, managers should monitor his status closer to tipoff to ensure he's in the lineup. Reid is averaging 20 points, 8.7 rebounds and three assists per game this season.
 UPDATE: @hornets forward Naz Reid (illness) has been added as probable to the injury report for today’s game vs WAS https://t.co/OYjbbajeWk
